features.title: Global A11y Audit and Foundation
features.description: Establish a baseline accessibility posture for the entire web dashboard by auditing against WCAG 2.1 AA, fixing color contrast across all views, and adding structural navigation primitives (skip links, landmark regions) that every page inherits.

tasks.title: Audit all dashboard pages against WCAG 2.1 AA and produce a prioritized remediation checklist
tasks.description: Run automated (axe-core or similar) and manual keyboard/screen-reader passes across every route in the dashboard. Document failures by severity, component, and WCAG criterion. The output checklist gates the remaining accessibility work and ensures no high-impact violations are missed.
acceptanceCriteria: Every top-level route (Rex, SourceVision tabs, Hench, Settings, Token Usage) has been audited
All critical (WCAG A) violations are documented with file and component references
All serious (WCAG AA) violations are documented
Checklist is committed to docs/ and linked from TESTING.md

tasks.title: Fix color contrast, add prefers-contrast media query, skip-navigation links, ARIA landmark regions, and page titles across all dashboard routes
tasks.description: Addresses two related structural foundations in a single pass: (1) Identify all foreground/background color pairings failing WCAG 4.5:1 (normal text) and 3:1 (large text/UI components) ratios, update CSS variables or Tailwind tokens so fixes propagate globally, and add a prefers-contrast: more media query that tightens borders and suppresses decorative gradients for high-contrast OS modes. (2) Insert a visually-hidden 'Skip to main content' link as the first focusable element on every page, wrap the sidebar, main content, and toolbar in appropriate landmark elements (<nav>, <main>, <header>), and set a meaningful <title> that updates on every client-side route transition.
acceptanceCriteria: No text or interactive element fails WCAG 4.5:1 contrast ratio in light or dark mode
UI component boundaries (buttons, inputs, zone cards) meet 3:1 contrast
A prefers-contrast: more block in the global stylesheet strengthens borders and suppresses decorative gradients
Verified in both light and dark themes with axe-core
A skip link is the first focusable element on every route and visually appears on focus
Sidebar is wrapped in <nav aria-label='Primary navigation'>
Main content area is wrapped in <main>
Page <title> updates on every client-side route transition to reflect the current section
No duplicate landmark roles exist on any single page

features.title: Keyboard Navigation and Focus Management
features.description: Ensure every interactive control in the dashboard is reachable and operable by keyboard alone, with predictable focus order, visible indicators, and correct focus trap/restoration behavior for overlay panels.

tasks.title: Implement visible focus indicators and logical tab order across all interactive dashboard controls
tasks.description: Add a consistent, high-visibility focus ring (meets 3:1 contrast against adjacent colors) to every button, link, input, dropdown, and custom control. Audit and fix tab order so it follows reading order; use tabindex='-1' to remove non-interactive elements from the tab sequence rather than relying on CSS pointer-events.
acceptanceCriteria: Every focusable element shows a visible outline or ring that meets 3:1 contrast ratio
Tab order follows visual reading order on all dashboard pages
No interactive element is reachable only by mouse (no tabindex=-1 on active controls)
All custom components (status chips, density toggle, theme toggle) are keyboard operable

tasks.title: Implement focus trap and restoration for detail panels, modals, and slideout drawers
tasks.description: Any overlay component (PRD detail panel, zone slideout, smart-add dialog, settings drawer) must trap focus within itself while open and restore focus to the triggering element when closed. Escape key must dismiss the overlay and return focus.
acceptanceCriteria: Tab and Shift+Tab cycle only within an open panel/modal — focus does not escape to background content
Pressing Escape closes the overlay and returns focus to the element that opened it
Screen reader virtual cursor is confined to the modal region (aria-modal=true or role=dialog with aria-labelledby)
Regression test covers open → tab-cycle → Escape → focus restored sequence for at least the PRD detail panel and zone slideout

features.title: Screen Reader and ARIA Semantics
features.description: Add correct ARIA roles, labels, and live regions to dynamic and complex components so screen reader users receive the same information as sighted users, including status changes, tree navigation, and data visualizations.

tasks.title: Add ARIA semantics, live regions, and accessible labels to PRD tree, status chips, toasts, meters, and data tables across the dashboard
tasks.description: A single comprehensive ARIA annotation pass covering two related component groups: (1) The PRD tree is a hierarchical disclosure widget requiring role=tree/treeitem, aria-expanded, and aria-level; status chips need text labels beyond color alone; toasts and banners need role=status or role=alert so screen readers announce them without requiring focus movement. (2) Token usage bars, duration chips, and budget percentage meters communicate state only visually and each needs an aria-label or aria-describedby restating the value textually; data tables in the Hench run history and token usage views must have proper <th scope> and caption elements.
acceptanceCriteria: PRD tree nodes carry role=treeitem, aria-expanded, and aria-level reflecting their hierarchy depth
Each status chip has an aria-label or visually-hidden text that conveys the state in words
Toast notifications use role=alert (errors) or role=status (informational) and are announced by screen readers without focus change
Tree keyboard interaction follows the ARIA Authoring Practices treeview pattern (arrow keys to navigate, Enter/Space to activate)
Every progress bar / meter has role=meter with aria-valuenow, aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax, and aria-label
Token budget percentage is readable as text by a screen reader without navigating to the visual bar
All tabular data has <th scope='col'|'row'> headers and a visible or visually-hidden <caption>
Verified with VoiceOver or NVDA: reading the token usage view produces meaningful output without visual context

features.title: SourceVision Zones Graph Accessibility
features.description: The SourceVision zones graph is an interactive SVG-based visualization with expandable zone nodes, cross-zone connection bars, and file-level hover/select states. It requires dedicated accessibility work to be operable without a mouse.

tasks.title: Make the SourceVision zones graph keyboard-navigable with arrow-key traversal and zone expand/collapse
tasks.description: Currently the zones graph is mouse-only. Implement keyboard navigation so users can Tab into the graph, use arrow keys to move between zone nodes, Enter/Space to expand or collapse a zone, and navigate into the file list within an expanded zone. Focus indicators must be visible on zone nodes.
acceptanceCriteria: Tab moves focus into the zones graph container; subsequent Tab moves through zone nodes in DOM order
Arrow keys (Up/Down) move focus between sibling zone nodes when the graph list is expanded
Enter/Space expands or collapses the focused zone node
Within an expanded zone, Tab navigates to individual file rows; Escape returns focus to the zone header
All focus states have visible indicators meeting 3:1 contrast

tasks.title: Add ARIA roles, labels, and textual descriptions to zone nodes, file rows, and cross-zone indicator bars
tasks.description: Zone nodes, file rows, and the cross-zone connection indicator bars are currently purely visual. Add aria-label to each zone card describing its name, cohesion, coupling, and file count. Each file row should carry an aria-label with the filename and zone assignment. The cross-zone bar segments colored by target zone need a textual alternative describing the target zone name.
acceptanceCriteria: Each zone node has aria-label='<zone name>, <N> files, cohesion <X>, coupling <Y>'
Each file row has aria-label='<filename>, zone <zone name>'
Cross-zone indicator bar segments have aria-label='<N> imports to <target zone name>'
Color is never the sole means of conveying zone identity — zone name text or aria-label always accompanies color coding
Screen reader narrates meaningful zone summary when navigating to a zone node

tasks.title: Make the zone slideout panel and hover tooltips accessible via keyboard and screen reader
tasks.description: The zone detail slideout currently opens only on mouse hover or click. Ensure it can be opened via Enter/Space on the focused zone row, traps focus while open, and is announced by screen readers as a dialog or complementary region. Hover tooltips (zone stats, file import counts) must have keyboard-accessible equivalents.
acceptanceCriteria: Zone slideout opens on Enter or Space when a zone row has focus
Slideout carries role=dialog or role=complementary with aria-label describing the zone
Focus moves into the slideout on open and returns to the triggering row on Escape or close
Tooltip content is available as an aria-describedby reference, not only on hover
Regression test verifies slideout opens, traps focus, and closes via keyboard

features.title: SourceVision UI Pages Accessibility
features.description: Apply accessibility fixes to every tab and sub-frame within the SourceVision section of the dashboard: Overview, Files, Import Graph, PR Markdown, and Zones list view. Each view must meet WCAG AA independently.

tasks.title: Audit and remediate accessibility for SourceVision Overview, Files, and PR Markdown tabs
tasks.description: Run WCAG AA checks on the Overview stats panel, the Files search/filter table, and the PR Markdown tab (rendered preview and raw toggle). Fix all critical and serious violations: missing form labels on the file search input, unlabeled status badges, and inaccessible copy-to-clipboard button.
acceptanceCriteria: File search input has a visible or visually-hidden <label> or aria-label
Files table has correct <th scope='col'> headers for all columns
PR Markdown preview/raw toggle buttons have descriptive aria-label reflecting current mode
Copy-to-clipboard button has aria-label='Copy PR markdown to clipboard' and provides feedback via aria-live on success
axe-core reports zero critical or serious violations on these three tabs

tasks.title: Make the SourceVision Import Graph visualization keyboard-accessible with a navigable table alternative
tasks.description: The import graph is an interactive node-link diagram. Provide full keyboard navigation (Tab to enter, arrow keys to move between nodes, Enter to select) and ensure each node carries an aria-label with file path and import count. Because complex graphs are difficult to make fully accessible, also provide a structured table fallback view listing all import edges that screen readers can traverse.
acceptanceCriteria: Tab moves focus into the graph container; arrow keys navigate between graph nodes
Each node has aria-label='<filename>, <N> imports, <M> dependents'
A 'View as table' toggle renders all import edges as a sortable <table> with proper headers
The table fallback is the default view when prefers-reduced-motion is set
Graph controls (zoom in/out, reset, filter) are keyboard operable with descriptive aria-labels
